Use the first official print and do not substitute later revisions.","dataPointId":"cdc.nchs.vsrr_infant_mortality.rates_by_age.infant_mortality.12_month_ending.2025_q4.first_print","historicalContext":[{"label":"2024 Q4 annual-window rate","value":5.54},{"label":"2025 Q1 annual-window rate","value":5.5},{"label":"2025 Q2 annual-window rate","value":5.46},{"label":"2025 Q3 annual-window rate","value":5.45}],"drivers":["pre-release 12-month-ending series was trending lower through 2025 Q3","persistence from the latest available 2025 Q3 value dominates the forecast","recent one-quarter declines averaged about 0.03 points","interval widened modestly for provisional reporting and first-print uncertainty"],"sourceContext":["https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nvss/vsrr/infant-mortality-dashboard.htm","https://data.cdc.gov/resource/jqwm-z2g9.json","https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/pressroom/calendar/2026_schedule.htm"],"runAt":"2026-07-07T13:54:58Z","reasoning":[{"kind":"heading","text":"US 2025 provisional infant mortality first print"},{"kind":"text","text":"Framing and exact resolver: this targets the CDC/NCHS VSRR infant mortality dashboard, not final linked birth/infant death file data. The variant is Rates by Age, Infant mortality, 12 Month-ending, 2025 Q4, with rates per 1,000 live births and two-decimal agency rounding."},{"kind":"tool","tool":"official.lookup","call":"Opened CDC/NCHS infant mortality dashboard notes and source metadata available for the public VSRR series.","result":"Dashboard states infant mortality rates are deaths under age 1 per 1,000 live births; estimates for 2025 are provisional; the relevant dashboard covers 2023 through Quarter 4 2025 and uses rates per 1,000 live births."},{"kind":"tool","tool":"official.lookup","call":"Opened CDC/NCHS 2026 statistical release calendar for the scheduled first release date.","result":"Calendar lists 05/26/26 for 'Quarterly Provisional Estimates of Infant Mortality: 2023 - Q4 2025' and 07/29/26 for the next Q1 2026 update."},{"kind":"tool","tool":"official.lookup","call":"Fetched CDC Socrata dataset jqwm-z2g9 for pre-resolution Rates by Age, Infant mortality, 12 Month-ending values through 2025 Q3 only.","result":"Fetched pre-target rates: 2023 Q1 5.69, 2023 Q2 5.69, 2023 Q3 5.65, 2023 Q4 5.63, 2024 Q1 5.61, 2024 Q2 5.61, 2024 Q3 5.56, 2024 Q4 5.54, 2025 Q1 5.50, 2025 Q2 5.46, 2025 Q3 5.45."},{"kind":"tool","tool":"official.lookup","call":"Fetched recent comparable annual-window observations from the same CDC/NCHS VSRR series for the local trend reference class.","result":"Fetched latest comparable values before the target: 2024 Q4 5.54, 2025 Q1 5.50, 2025 Q2 5.46, 2025 Q3 5.45."},{"kind":"text","text":"Reference class/base rate: the directly comparable official annual-window infant mortality observations before the 2025 Q4 target show a gradual decline from 5.69 in 2023 Q1 to 5.45 in 2025 Q3, with the last four pre-target annual-window values at 5.54, 5.50, 5.46, and 5.45."},{"kind":"math","text":"Prior/update/interval: persistence prior was the latest available 2025 Q3 annual-window rate of 5.45. Historical sample was 2023 Q1 through 2025 Q3 from the same Rates by Age, Infant mortality, 12 Month-ending variant. Successive changes were 0.00, -0.04, -0.02, -0.02, 0.00, -0.05, -0.02, -0.04, -0.04, -0.01, so sigma = 0.018; 1.28*sigma = 0.023. I apply a -0.03 momentum adjustment, close to the recent average quarterly annual-window decline, giving 5.42. I widen to a 0.04 half-width, about 1.7x the raw half-width, for first-print provisional uncertainty and uneven quarterly reporting, implying 5.38 to 5.46."},{"kind":"text","text":"Level and momentum: the 12-month-ending level had eased from 5.54 in 2024 Q4 to 5.45 in 2025 Q3, so a further but not abrupt decline is the central pre-release expectation."},{"kind":"text","text":"Counter-considerations: upside risk would come from late reporting or a rebound in neonatal deaths that leaves the first print above 5.46; downside risk would come from a broader decline in postneonatal or SIDS deaths and would land below the interval if the first print were under 5.38."},{"kind":"text","text":"Review disposition: accepted the leakage, update, interval, prior/update/interval, and historical-context critiques by excluding the 2025 Q4 target value and components, keeping the CDC/NCHS resolver unchanged, and recomputing the point and interval from pre-release history through 2025 Q3 only."},{"kind":"forecast","point":5.42,"ciLow":5.38,"ciHigh":5.46}]}
